speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
text: asked the Minister for Law whether the Ministry can provide an update on the outcomes of the Singapore Land Authority's coordination efforts to preserve orderliness of the Waterloo Mall especially outside the temples where illegal hawking is rife.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
text: From time to time, there are incidences of unlicensed street hawkers such as tissue paper vendors or individuals soliciting donations in the area.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
text: Agencies are mindful that the unlicensed street hawkers in the area are of a mixed profile.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
text: Some are elderly and some appear to have medical conditions.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
text: Some also may face more complex challenges such as social isolation.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
text: While these in any combination, may form their motivation for illegal hawking, it may not always be the case.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
text: SPF will intervene as necessary when law-and-order issues arise.
